summary: Defines the 608 Rejected response code for the Session Initiation Protocol. It tells a caller that an intermediary, such as an analytics engine, rejected the call so it will not be delivered. As a 6xx code, it signals that retrying the same user agent is likely to fail.

eli5.summary: When a phone call is blocked by a spam filter, this gives the caller a clear message that the call was rejected on the way.

questions: how sip tells caller call was blocked
